description:
Moves the dependency-graph methods onto a `graph()` facade.

## Background

`CommandExecutor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`) carries every command family in one public surface of about 195 methods across 28 `impl` blocks, so a consumer of one family accepts all of them. This family lives in `commands/graph.rs` and `commands/dependency.rs`: `publish_graph_export`, `build_dependency_tree`, `show_dependencies_with_depth`, `show_rdeps_with_depth`, `show_roots`, `export_graph`, `export_graph_batch`, `resolve_hierarchy_tree`, `detect_divergences`, `add_dependency`, `add_dependency_with_policy`, `remove_dependency`, `add_dependencies`, `add_dependencies_with_policy` and `remove_dependencies`. Callers: the dep, graph and divergence arms of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or their handler modules), `commands/issue.rs`, `commands/gate_check.rs`, `commands/breakdown.rs`, the server route tests that add dependencies (`crates/server/src/routes.rs`), and the dependency and graph suites.

The facade shape: `CommandExecutor::<family>()` returns a borrowing struct holding `&CommandExecutor<S>`; the family's methods live in `impl` blocks on that struct in the family's own `commands/` file, and each block keeps the storage bound its `impl CommandExecutor` block had (`IssueStore`, `IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore`, or concrete `JsonFileStorage`). The kernel (sessions, rule and config caches, `require_active_lease`, the validation `capture_*` helpers) stays on `CommandExecutor`; a facade method reaches it through its executor reference, and calls into another family go through that family's accessor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CommandExecutor::graph()` returns `GraphOps<'_, S>`, re-exported from `jit::commands`, and every public method listed in the Background is a method of `GraphOps` rather than of `CommandExecutor`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each `GraphOps` impl block for these methods carries the storage bound of the `CommandExecutor` block it replaces, so no method becomes callable on a storage it could not use before.
- [hard] REQ-03: Callers in `crates/jit`, `crates/server` and their test suites reach the moved methods through `graph()`, intra-doc links name the new paths, and the workspace builds, lints and passes its existing suites with no assertion changed.

## Notes

- Behaviour, output and exit codes are unchanged; the compile and the existing suites are the test boundary.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Graph and dependency methods behind a graph facade
